Protein Food

Rabbit Leg

About This Entry

Rabbit leg is braised or confit-style slow-cooked — richer than saddle with more connective tissue. Mustard, olive, and wine braises pair with southern French reds and Italian natives.

Beginner Guide

Hind legs are meatier than forelegs. Low moist heat until tender; falls-off-bone is the goal.

FAQ

What is Rabbit Leg?
Hind legs are meatier than forelegs.
How should Rabbit Leg be cooked for best results?
Lean game benefits from careful doneness — avoid overcooking loins; braise tougher cuts. Rest before slicing.
